diagnosis: Congenital simple hamartoma of the retinal pigment epithelium
legend: This discrete heavily pigmented simple retinal pigment epithelium hamartoma is located near the fovea.

diagnosis: Congenital simple hamartoma of the retinal pigment epithelium
legend: Optical coherence tomography of this simple retinal pigment epithelium hamartoma shows a discrete full-thickness lesion with surface hyperreflectivity and deep optical shadowing.

diagnosis: Combined hamartoma of the retina and retinal pigment epithelium
legend: The epiretinal glial component of this grey subfoveal combined hamartoma exerts vitreoretinal traction on retinal vessels.

diagnosis: Combined hamartoma of the retina and retinal pigment epithelium
legend: Optical coherence tomography of this combined hamartoma discloses a focal area of thickened disorganized retina with an epiretinal membrane and retinal folds.

diagnosis: Combined hamartoma of the retina and retinal pigment epithelium
legend: There is abnormal organization of the retinal layers of the juxtapapillary retina; pigmented cells are evident in the retinal layers.

diagnosis: Combined hamartoma of the retina and retinal pigment epithelium
legend: There is a thin epiretinal membrane on the surface of the retina; the organization of the retinal layers is abnormal and pigmented cells are evident within the superficial retinal layers.
